notes.title: Color Breakers 2 Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The day is finally here, the Color Breakers 2 Demo is available now for you to try it out! The demo supports 8 players in both couch and online co-op, so grab your friends and play it together to have some fun!

Join the game's Discord if you want to talk about the game and follow the development process: https://discord.gg/nrPCEyEqU4

Please also help us with wishlisting the game, it really means a lot <3
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2876640/Color_Breakers_2/

See you in the game!

notes.title: Color Breakers 2 Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I've been working on Color Breakers 2 for more than a year and I just wanted to let you all know that I'll be releasing a Demo soon for you to finally try out the game!

Stay tuned for the announcement and wishlist Color Breakers 2 to support us: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2876640/Color_Breakers_2/

notes.title: Color Breakers 2 is coming in 2025!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm finally excited to announce that Color Breakers 2 is coming to Steam in 2025! I've been working on this game for the last 2 years and I hope it brings you even more fun and joy than Color Breakers!

The game will feature 8 player local and online multiplayer and more chaos than ever before. Please stay tuned in the following months for more announcements and to follow the game's development.

I'd like to take this opportunity to encourage you to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2876640/Color_Breakers_2]wishlist the game[/url], it helps a lot!

Thanks for your support and see you in Color Breakers 2!

notes.title: V 2.2
notes.content:
- Add localization support for 5 new languages, including: Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Thai and Korean.
- Updated Keyboard and Mouse icons.
- Add menu option inside the game to change the language.
- Default selected server based on language to give players a better experience when playing online.
- Added credits scene when completing the last level of the game.
- Add support for Nintendo Switch Pro Controller.
- Fix multiple minor bugs and issues.

notes.title: Crossplay now available!
notes.content:
With the recent release of Color Breakers on Switch, players can now play together with friends on different platforms.

Have fun!!!

notes.title: Color Breakers coming to Nintendo Switch with Crossplay!
notes.content:
With the release of Color Breakers on the Nintendo Switch on July 7, players will be able to play together regardless of the platform.

Tell your friends, grab those colors and have some fun!!!

https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/color-breakers-switch

notes.title: Patch Notes V2.1
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
- Added option to change Key Bindings for mouse too, now players who use mouse and keyboard have full control over the way they want to play.
- You can now use the mouse to navigate the menus, giving mouse and keyboard players more freedom while playing the game.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fix bug where game would start when all players left the room while playing Local Campaign.

notes.title: V 2.0 - Versus Mode
notes.content:
[h1]V 2.0[/h1]

[h2]Versus Mode![/h2]

Introducing the new Versus Mode! Compete against your friends in versus mode both locally and online to prove once and for all who is the best painter of all time.

Includes:
- 5 new unique battle stages.
- Red vs Blue team action.
- First team to complete 5 paintings wins.
- Tons of chaos, fun and ruined friendships.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

- Improved menu navigation controls.
- Fixed issue where extra characters would randomly spawn when joining an online match.
- Fixed some issues that were causing disconnects when playing online.
- Improved online gameplay stability.

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.1
notes.content:
[h2]New Changes[/h2]
- Added option to change key bindings in the Settings menu.
- Improved game performance on older hardware.
- Improved server stability when playing online.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed bug where mouse was not working properly when playing online.
- Fixed bug where some unsupported controllers were causing random unexpected input.

notes.title: Save the Date!
notes.content:
Thanks for your support and interest in the game. I'm happy to announce that you won't have to wait much longer to play the game.

Color Breakers is coming out on July 9th! Add the game to your wishlist and be ready to ruin your friendships when the game launches!

-deleon
